objective_lattice_ceiling_v3_lineage.lineage_only_reason: The unchanged 128-ULP envelope is retained for hostile-test and audit lineage, but the rejected 49811 smoke-02 row violates its dual-overshoot premise; it is not enlarged and v3 is not a formal authority for the next run.
objective_lattice_ceiling_v3_lineage.full_objective_rule: P_full=P+C and B_full=B+C. For a code-0 solve, first require P_full on the declared objective lattice. Let e be the registered 128-ULP dual-bound envelope and delta=up(abs(F-P)), both computed from raw binary64 values before adding C. Require delta+e<step/2 and up(max(0,B-P))<=e. Then compute safe=down(B_full-e), scaled_safe=down((safe-offset)/step), closed=offset+step*ceil(scaled_safe), and require closed to equal the primal lattice level.
objective_lattice_ceiling_v3_lineage.solver_primal_same_level_rule: directed-up abs(F-P) plus the registered dual-bound envelope must be strictly smaller than half the declared lattice step
objective_lattice_ceiling_v3_lineage.solver_vector_same_level_rule: before adding C, directed-up abs(X-P) and abs(F-X), where X=c@res.x is reconstructed live, must each be strictly smaller than half the declared lattice step; the certificate independently checks F against P
objective_lattice_ceiling_v3_lineage.exact_readback_feasibility_rule: before SolverResult construction or lattice closure, the assignment-derived canonical readback must satisfy every active stage row: exact U equals u_eq; exact Z is at most z_le plus the already registered lexicographic_row_slack; and exact W is at most w_le plus that same registered slack
objective_lattice_ceiling_v3_lineage.boundary_rule: Structural identities remain at eight ULP. Before adding C, the live X=c@res.x must satisfy up(abs(X-P))<step/2 and up(abs(F-X))<step/2; the certificate separately checks F/P. The separate e=128*ulp(max(1,|P|,|B|,|C|,|P+C|,|B+C|,step,|offset|)) envelope is subtracted from B_full with directed-down rounding. Raw delta=up(abs(F-P)) and signed B-P are checked before adding C so cancellation cannot hide disagreement. The strict delta+e<step/2 guard establishes that the solver incumbent and exact feasible readback identify the same lattice level; none of these is an enlarged absolute tolerance. INT_TOL never moves a dual bound.
objective_lattice_ceiling_v3_lineage.certificate_scope: superseded formal lineage only: the unchanged 128-ULP construction remains documented and hostile-tested but is not an admissible formal certificate method for the next recovery-06 run
objective_lattice_ceiling_v3_lineage.solver_numeric_premise: Historical v3 premise only: B is no smaller than B-e, directed-up abs(F-P)+e is strictly below half a step, and raw max(0,B-P)<=e. Smoke-02 showed that this premise is not met by every code-0 role. The envelope remains exactly 128 ULP, is never enlarged, and cannot authorize the next formal run.
objective_lattice_ceiling_v3_lineage.Z_step_proof: integral effective durations imply an integral canonical optimum W; w4 is in {0,5,10,20,50,100}; gcd(W2=5,w4,W5=1000)=5
objective_lattice_ceiling_v3_lineage.W_step_proof: for any integer-duration assignment, the positive W objective takes the canonical minimum O=max(0,load-H_STD), which is integral

status0_lattice_consistency_certificate.claim_wording: Under the registered status-0 Optimal solver contract and exact-feasible lattice readback, the returned incumbent, live vector reconstruction, and persisted primal/dual diagnostics are mutually consistent with the same unique attainable objective level.
status0_lattice_consistency_certificate.claim_scope: conditional solver-status and unique-lattice-cell consistency; not an independent lower-bound proof and not a proof that the floating-point solver is correct
status0_lattice_consistency_certificate.strict_boundary_rule: Every registered pairwise distance uses nextafter(abs(a-b), +infinity) < step/2; equality and adjacent-cell evidence fail closed.
status0_lattice_consistency_certificate.solver_primal_same_level_rule: directed-up abs(F-P), abs(B-P), and abs(F-B) must each be strictly smaller than half the declared lattice step; this validates a code-0 solver-reported optimum but is not an exact mathematical proof
status0_lattice_consistency_certificate.solver_vector_same_level_rule: before adding C, directed-up abs(X-P) and abs(F-X), where X=c@res.x is reconstructed live, must each be strictly smaller than half the declared lattice step; the certificate independently checks F against P
status0_lattice_consistency_certificate.raw_gap_consistency_rule: The landed raw solver gap must replay exactly from immutable F and B under the registered solver-native gap arithmetic; the landed full-objective gap or zero-denominator reason must replay exactly from immutable P, B, and C.

structural_lower_bound_certificate.deviation_constant_authority: For every re-parsed (rho,seed,absent) H/S instance, dev_const=len(xbar) is recomputed before validation; U/W roles require C=0, D requires C=dev_const, weighted Z requires C=w4*dev_const, and P must equal exact_full_objective-C.
structural_lower_bound_certificate.proof_rule: Recompute the full objective as an integer from the exact feasible assignment. If it equals the registered integer analytic lower bound exactly, then lower_bound <= OPT <= exact_feasible_objective = lower_bound. Raw F, B, C and gaps remain immutable but B does not participate in this proof.
